
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19622998" title="发布于 2026-02-24 08:23">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-Null 条件分配（Null-conditional assignment）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="p1">上篇文章中给大家介绍了：</p>
<div class="postTitle"><a class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19622970">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-扩展成员Extension Members</a></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<p class="p1">今天继续给大家分享：Null 条件分配（Null-conditional assignment）</p>
<p class="p1">C# 14 中新增了一种语法能力：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="p1">允许在使用 <span class="s1">?. 时进行赋值操作</span></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="p1"><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 16px">一、原有代码实现方案</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px"><span class="s1">obj?.Property = 10;&nbsp; &nbsp;// ❌ 编译错误</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px"><span class="s1">?. 只能用于访问或调用：</span></p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">obj?.Method();<br>var x = obj?.Property;</p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">不能用于赋值。</p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span style="font-size: 16px"><span class="s1">二、</span>C# 14：允许 Null 条件赋值</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">现在可以直接这么写：</p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">obj?.Property = <span class="s1">10;</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px"><span class="s1">等价于：</span></p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">if (obj != null)<br>{<br>    obj.Property = 10;<br>}</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">以这个代码示例：</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">receiver?.Member = value;</p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">语义：&nbsp;</p>
<ol start="1">
<li style="list-style-type: none"><ol>
<li>
<p class="p1">只对 <span class="s1">receiver 进行一次求值</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">如果为 null，整个表达式直接结束</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">如果不为 null，则执行赋值</p>
</li>
</ol></li>
</ol>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">&nbsp;<span class="s2">不会抛出 NullReferenceException</span></p>
<p><strong><span class="s2" style="font-size: 16px">三、典型应用场景</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong>简化防御式编程</strong></p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">&nbsp;原有：</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">if (user != null)<br>{<br>    user.Name = "Tom";<br>}</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">现在：</p>
<p style="margin-left: 30px">user?.Name = "Tom";</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong>结合链式调用</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;order?.Customer?.Address = newAddress;</p>
<p>&nbsp;等价于：</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong>if (order?.Customer != null)</p>
<p>&nbsp;{<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; order.Customer.Address = newAddress;<br>&nbsp;}</p>
<p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 15px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 16px">四、<strong>与 ??= 的区别</strong></span></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>??=</strong><strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">是“空值合并赋值”</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>obj ??= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> MyClass();</pre>
</div>
<blockquote>如果 obj 是 null，则赋新值。</blockquote>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>?.</strong><strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">赋值是“存在才赋值”</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>obj?.Property = value;</pre>
</div>
<blockquote>如果 obj 不为 null，才执行赋值。</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/23525/202602/23525-20260218114853014-1321937828.png" alt="image" width="454" height="99" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;五、性能分析</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">✔ 没有额外性能损耗</p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">✔ 与手写 null 判断几乎一致</p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">✔ JIT 会优化</p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-left: 30px">对高频代码路径安全。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;周国庆</p>
<p>&nbsp;20260220</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p>

</div>
